passages.text: Opuntia leucotricha is a species of cactus with the common names: arborescent pricklypear, Aaron's beard cactus, and semaphore cactus; and (in Spanish) duraznillo blanco and nopal blanco.

Description
Opuntia leucotricha is a tree-like cactus, growing up to {{convert|5|m|ft}} tall. The platyclades have a thin fuzz of white hairs on their joints.
The plant is an invasive species in Florida.

Distribution
The plant is endemic to Mexico. The cactus occurs in mountain habitats, in the states of: San Luis Potosí, Tamaulipas, Zacatecas, Guanajuato, and Querétaro.
